claims.speaker: char:miriam
claims.content: I kept the packet because I was afraid of losing him.
claims.note: Only the speech act is confirmed; do not promote its content without separate evidence.

cognitions.content: Elise knew the accusation had relied on paper older than Miriam’s licence.
cognitions.note: Confirmed that this character holds/held this epistemic attitude, not that a belief or suspicion is objectively true.

cognitions.content: Jonas had believed the packet was an accusation, but it contained his mother’s request for an apprenticeship.

cognitions.content: Elise could not know whether the silent man at the edge of the crowd had read the notice.
cognitions.note: Confirmed that this character holds/held this epistemic attitude, not that a belief or suspicion is objectively true.

cognitions.content: Jonas believed the apprentices would keep their own dated copies.

cognitions.content: Jonas knows the packet contains his mother’s request for an apprenticeship under the name Dunn.
cognitions.note: Correction of the explicitly former belief, not an active continuation of it.

relations.statement: Elise trusted Jonas to keep the proofs without hiding inconvenient names.

hooks.statement: The retired watermark and dated ledger identify the paper stock as older than the licence period named in the accusation.
The mismatched letter belonged to the former mill owner’s private press.
The packet contained Jonas’s mother’s apprenticeship request under the name Dunn.
The dated proof showed Miriam had prepared a correction before the threat arrived.

mustNotRecord.statement: She intended to teach the apprentices to keep every dated proof.
mustNotRecord.reason: An intention is not a completed event.

mustNotRecord.statement: If the public kept the correction, the false leaflet might lose its authority.
mustNotRecord.reason: A conditional proposition is not an actual world state.

mustNotRecord.statement: She dreamed of a press making no sound at all.
mustNotRecord.reason: Dream content is not waking canon.

uncertainties.statement: Elise could not know whether the silent man at the edge of the crowd had read the notice.
uncertainties.note: Retain uncertainty. Where no definite proposition is offered, recording only a suspects cognition or omitting a world fact is valid.

reviewPolicies.factModes: 数量世界事实有独立叙述；reported记录原话来源，不作为唯一世界事实模式。允许持久层narrated并另记claim，不要求重复世界事实。recalled映射到recalled_past。
reviewPolicies.cognitionTiming: 新增acquiredChapter与P1结算章一致；实际旧信念形成时间未知另记null，不伪造0。明确被纠正的旧信念须supersede，不作为章末活跃态度。 同章已结束的历史态度不强制新加为活跃认知；输入中已有旧条目才要求supersede，不要求P1不支持的同批新增后再替换操作。
reviewPolicies.cognitionVia: 明确电话转告、读文件/日志或推断时按上下文判；泛泛的believed/不知道/猜测并未交代途径时，默认inferred不能作为唯一严格命中条件。viaScored=false及acceptedVia是金标评分元数据，不直接写入P1 schema。
reviewPolicies.traps: mustNotRecord只禁止把给定计划/假设/梦境证据直接实化，不排斥后续独立证据已证实的事实。
reviewPolicies.uncertainty: confirmed认知确认的是态度；被怀疑的世界命题仍只能未确认或不抽取。未提出具体命题时不强制编出一项事实。
reviewPolicies.identifiers: F/K/H编号是本故事的参考标识。实际运行按语义与来源映射；新增纠正和supersede引用必须使用一致的实际分配ID，不逐字强制与金标编号一致。
